BiblicalUsage: A fixed quantity is what this word counts: the tale of bricks Pharaoh still demanded when the straw was taken away, and the measure of the ephah and the bath, each a tenth part of a homer.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the measure tells two stories at once: Pharaoh's measure was a burden, and the Lord's measure was a standard.
